transform_img_normalize_and_reshape: transform an image tensor to a normalized RGB array using dimension object for reshaping
transform_img_single_channel_to_rgb: transform a single channel image into a 3 channel RGB image by tiling the channel
transform_img_multi_depth_to_rgb: transform a multi depth image with more than 4 channels into a single depth RGB image
save_img_write_to_disk: save a transformed image tensor to disk at the specified file path using matplotlib
save_img_with_transform_pipeline: save an image by first transforming it through normalization and channel handling then writing to disk
